findings.text: 频繁管理DSH工作区与会话的人可以在行上集中执行常用操作，避免来回找按钮。
Client用DOM和React私有fiber找身份，调用宿主服务或本插件Host路由；偏好保存在localStorage，会话删除使用持久待删队列。
固定2.0.3，定向读取Host/Client身份、请求信任、待删、目录rm和产物关键链，未执行文件管理器、删除、测试或宿主验收，不审计整个DSH权限系统。
manifest根包名@dsh-external/dsh-workspace-menu，README另给npm安装名；不据文档认定包身份迁移和发布产物已验证，源码导出lib关键路径已定向核查。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 插件文件与独立备份 | 核对版本、来源和fiber目标 | 金额/工时未知 |
| 持续使用 | DOM observer/RAF、本地偏好、重试timer | 核对目标和删除排队 | 大列表性能和净节时未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 外部备份、部分状态重建 | 区分记录/目录/registry阶段 | 永久rm没有内建撤销保证 |
| 退出 | 保留数据及偏好 | 检查待删标记、取消归档与清理偏好 | 重新启用可能恢复待删处理 |
[Q03](#research-q03) 先观察并优先核查Host目标绑定与恢复。关闭危险菜单不约束Host接口；研究只用可丢弃副本，出目标偏差或部分删除立即停止，回原生入口并用备份恢复。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 操作入口 | 行菜单集中原生动作 | 人时与误操作改善 |
| 生命周期 | Host租约和Client清理 | 全部宿主升级兼容 |
| 删除交付 | queued/deleted区分与UI中止 | 目标授权、部分状态一致和恢复完整性 |
[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03) root Context路由租约、引用计数和effect清理值得复用；Client退出清observer/事件/RAF。它们减少重复注册与残留，不能替代永久删除授权与恢复。
[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02) 把常用行操作与跨平台Host能力集中，并明确会话实际删除/等待状态；业务能力多数继承宿主，未测净节时或误操作下降。
[Q02](#research-q02) Host目录删除虽有请求信任和保护路径，仍直接接受绝对path且未绑定registry目标或确认计划。UI会中止未完成会话后的目录删除，但整链仍可能部分成功且不可撤回。
[Q04](#research-q04) 可研究Host按workspace身份固定的一次性删除计划、逐步回执与可回收目录，用目标变化和阶段失败比较误删与恢复负担；现有双确认/排队已存在，未来增量未验证。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DSH0.2.x匹配服务 | 必需，manifest>=0.2.1-rc.3 | Host/Client控制器 | 不支持由旧版声明推断加载 |
| React/DOM行结构 | 菜单身份必需 | 恢复workspace/session ID | 私有结构变化会失效或影响定位 |
| 本机文件管理器 | 打开目录时必需 | 平台opener | 命令失败返回错误；spawn成功不等用户已看到 |
| 可写DSH_HOME | 会话待删必需 | 队列和记录清理 | I/O/占用可保持queued |
| 独立备份和隔离数据 | 删除研究必需 | 处理不可逆/部分成功 | 不建议在唯一真实档案上试删 |

recommendation.reason: 频繁管理 DSH 会话与工作区的用户可以关注这个集中菜单，但应先解决 Host 删除目标绑定与恢复问题。相比原生按钮，它主要减少操作入口寻找，现有证据尚不足以覆盖永久删除和部分完成的负担。若目标路径与所选工作区不一致或出现部分删除，用户应停止插件操作并回到原生入口，由独立备份处理恢复。

publication.summaries.text: 为 DSH 首页工作区和会话提供右键与双击菜单，集中重命名、置顶、归档、路径及删除等操作。

items.界面: 工作区/会话行菜单与双击入口。
items.Host 路由: 文件管理器打开、会话待删和目录删除。
items.后台: 每30秒重试持久待删会话，停用清timer。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 行菜单 | 集中重命名、置顶、归档等操作 | 依赖私有fiber和宿主服务 |
| 文件管理器打开 | 打开本机目标 | 平台命令启动不保证可视结果 |
| 会话待删 | 占用解除后删除记录 | 可queued、可取消未执行项，永久操作需备份 |
| 工作区目录删除 | 递归移除目录后清registry | 接口未绑定workspace目标，可能部分成功 |

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

给 DSH 首页的工作区和会话加上右键菜单。双击也能打开：需要重命名、复制路径或归档会话时，不用再到处找按钮。

> **兼容性：** v2.0.0 及以后适用于 DSH 0.2.x（`>= 0.2.1-rc.3`）。DSH 0.1.x 请使用 [v1.2.0](https://github.com/0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu/releases/tag/v1.2.0)。

## 安装

通过 npm 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu
```

也可以从 [Releases](https://github.com/0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu/releases/latest) 下载安装包，在安装包所在目录运行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-external-dsh-workspace-menu-2.0.3.tgz
```

重启 DSH 后，在首页右键或双击工作区、会话即可使用。菜单项可以在 **设置 → 工作区菜单** 中分别开关；设置界面支持中文和英文。

从旧版包 `@dsh-external/dsh-workspace-menu` 切换到 npm 版时，请先移除旧版，避免重复加载。

## 能做什么

**工作区**

- 置顶或取消置顶、重命名
- 在文件管理器中打开、复制路径、新建会话
- 从列表中移除（保留磁盘文件），或删除工作区及其磁盘目录（二次确认）

**会话**

- 置顶或取消置顶、重命名、标记未读或已读
- 归档、取消归档、分叉会话
- 复制会话链接或标题，在新窗口中打开，打开所在目录
- 删除会话及其磁盘记录（二次确认）

## 使用说明

- 会话置顶与 DSH 自带的置顶功能共用状态；工作区置顶和会话未读标记保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage 中。
- 删除会话时会先归档并切到新对话；如果记录仍被 DSH 占用，插件会稍后重试。取消归档可取消尚未执行的删除。
- 文件管理器使用 Windows 资源管理器、macOS Finder，或 Linux 上可用的 `xdg-open`、`gio` 等程序。
- 新窗口使用插件提供的 `?session=<id>` 链接打开对应会话。
- 永久删除由插件的宿主路由处理，无需安装 `@mlgbnb/dsh-archive-manager`。会话记录位于 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<工作区 slug>/<sessionId>/`。
- 插件通过 DOM 事件和 React fiber 定位工作区和会话行，不修改 DSH 内置源码。

const defaultState = (): PersistedState => ({

function loadState(): PersistedState {
  try {

    if (!raw) return defaultState()
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PersistedState>
    return {
      pinnedWorkspaces: Array.isArray(parsed.pinnedWorkspaces) ? parsed.pinnedWorkspaces : [],
      unreadSessions: Array.isArray(parsed.unreadSessions) ? parsed.unreadSessions : [],
      features: { ...DEFAULT_FEATURES, ...(parsed.features ?? {}) },
    }
  } catch {
    return defaultState()
  }
}

/**
 * Read the React fiber attached to a built-in row DOM node and recover the
 * component props (group/node). This lets us map a row to its workspace/session
 * id without touching the built-in package source.
 */
function fiberPropsOf(el: Element): Record<string, any> | undefined {
  const key = Object.keys(el).find((k) => k.startsWith('__reactFiber$'))
  if (!key) return undefined
  let fiber: any = (el as any)[key]
  for (let i = 0; fiber && i < 30; i++) {
    const props = fiber.memoizedProps
    const sessionNode = props?.node?.id !== undefined
      && typeof props.node.updatedAt === 'number'
      && typeof props.node.blank === 'boolean'
    if (props && (props.group !== undefined || sessionNode)) return props
    fiber = fiber.return
  }
  return undefined
}

function rowInfo(el: Element): RowInfo | undefined {
  const props = fiberPropsOf(el)
  if (props?.node?.id !== undefined && typeof props.node.updatedAt === 'number' && typeof props.node.blank === 'boolean') {
    const node = props.node
    return {
      kind: 'session',
      id: String(node.id),
      title: String(node.title ?? node.displayTitle ?? ''),
    }
  }
  if (props?.group !== undefined) {
    const group = props.group
    const workspaceId = group.workspaceId === undefined ? '' : String(group.workspaceId)
    if (!workspaceId) return undefined
    return {
      kind: 'workspace',
      id: workspaceId,
      title: String(group.label ?? ''),
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

async function copyText(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
    return true
  } catch {
    try {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea')
      ta.value = text
      ta.style.position = 'fixed'
      ta.style.opacity = '0'
      document.body.appendChild(ta)
      ta.select()
      document.execCommand('copy')
      ta.remove()
      return true
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }
}

async function postJson(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<{ deleted?: boolean; queued?: boolean }> {
  const response = await fetch(path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = `failed (${response.status})`
    try {
      const data = await response.json() as { error?: { message?: string } | string }
      if (typeof data.error === 'string') message = data.error
      else if (data.error?.message) message = data.error.message
    } catch {
      // keep status message
    }
    throw new Error(message)
  }
  return await response.json() as { deleted?: boolean; queued?: boolean }
}

function removeMenu(): void {

function showMenu(x: number, y: number, items: MenuItem[]): void {
  removeMenu()
  const menu = document.createElement('div')
  menu.className = MENU_CLASS
  menu.setAttribute('role', 'menu')
  for (const item of items) {
    const button = document.createElement('button')
    button.type = 'button'
    button.className = `dsh-ws-menu-item${item.danger ? ' dsh-ws-menu-item-danger' : ''}`
    button.textContent = item.label
    button.disabled = item.disabled === true
    button.setAttribute('role', 'menuitem')
    button.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      event.stopPropagation()
      removeMenu()
      item.onClick()
    })
    menu.appendChild(button)
  }
  document.body.appendChild(menu)
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect()
  const margin = 8
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(margin, x), window.innerWidth - rect.width - margin)
  const top = Math.min(Math.max(margin, y), window.innerHeight - rect.height - margin)
  menu.style.left = `${left}px`
  menu.style.top = `${top}px`

  const close = (event: Event): void => {
    if (event.target instanceof Node && menu.contains(event.target)) return
    removeMenu()
    cleanup()
  }
  const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      removeMenu()
      cleanup()
    }
  }
  const onResize = (): void => {
    removeMenu()
    cleanup()
  }
  const cleanup = (): void => {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', close, true)
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    window.removeEventListener('blur', cleanup)
    window.removeEventListener('resize', cleanup)
  }
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', close, true)
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  window.addEventListener('blur', cleanup)
  window.addEventListener('resize', cleanup)
}

function promptText(ctx: ClientContext, title: string, initial: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const t = translator(ctx)
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    removeMenu()
    const old = document.querySelector(`.${MODAL_CLASS}`)
    old?.remove()
    const backdrop = document.createElement('div')
    backdrop.className = `${MODAL_CLASS}-backdrop`
    const box = document.createElement('div')
    box.className = MODAL_CLASS
    const heading = document.createElement('h3')
    heading.textContent = title
    const input = document.createElement('input')
    input.type = 'text'
    input.value = initial
    input.spellcheck = false
    const error = document.createElement('div')
    error.className = `${MODAL_CLASS}-error`
    error.style.display = 'none'
    const footer = document.createElement('div')
    footer.className = `${MODAL_CLASS}-footer`
    const cancel = document.createElement('button')
    cancel.type = 'button'
    cancel.textContent = t('dialog.cancel')
    const ok = document.createElement('button')
    ok.type = 'button'
    ok.className = `${MODAL_CLASS}-ok`
    ok.textContent = t('dialog.confirm')
    const close = (result: string | null): void => {
      backdrop.remove()
      resolve(result)
    }
    cancel.addEventListener('click', () => close(null))
    ok.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const value = input.value.trim()
      if (!value) {
        error.textContent = t('dialog.nameEmpty')
        error.style.display = 'block'
        return
      }
      close(value)
    })
    input.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') ok.click()
      if (event.key === 'Escape') close(null)
    })
    backdrop.addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => {
      if (event.target === backdrop) close(null)
    })
    footer.append(cancel, ok)
    box.append(heading, input, error, footer)
    backdrop.appendChild(box)
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop)
    input.focus()
    input.select()
  })
}

function refreshBadges(ctx: ClientContext): void {
  const state = loadState()
  const pinned = pinnedSessions(ctx)
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="treeitem"]')
  for (const row of rows) {
    const info = rowInfo(row)
    if (!info) continue
    if (info.kind === 'workspace') {
      row.dataset.dshWorkspaceId = info.id || undefined
      row.dataset.dshPinned = state.pinnedWorkspaces.includes(info.id) ? 'true' : 'false'
      row.dataset.dshUnread = 'false'
    } else {
      row.dataset.dshSessionId = info.id
      row.dataset.dshPinned = pinned.includes(info.id) ? 'true' : 'false'
      row.dataset.dshUnread = state.unreadSessions.includes(info.id) ? 'true' : 'false'
    }
  }
}

function workspaceMenu(ctx: ClientContext, workspaceId: string, title: string): MenuItem[] {

  const state = loadState()

  const pinned = state.pinnedWorkspaces.includes(workspaceId)

      id: 'pin',

        if (!pinned) {

        openInExplorer(ws.path).catch((e) => {

  }

    items.push({
      id: 'new-session',
      label: t('menu.newSession'),

        if (!ok) return
        ctx.workspaces.delete(workspaceId).catch((e) => {
          console.warn('[dsh-workspace-menu] delete workspace failed', e)
          flashMessage(t('toast.removeFailed'))
        })

    })

  if (isFeatureEnabled(state, 'workspaceDeleteDisk')) {
    items.push({
      id: 'delete-disk',
      label: t('menu.deleteWorkspace'),
      danger: true,
      disabled: !ws,
      onClick: () => {
        if (!ws) return
        const first = window.confirm(t('dialog.deleteWorkspace', { title }))
        if (!first) return
        const second = window.confirm(t('dialog.deleteWorkspaceTwice', { title }))
        if (!second) return
        const run = async (): Promise<void> => {
          for (const sessionId of ws.sessionIds) {
            if (!await deleteSessionRecord(sessionId)) throw new Error(t('toast.deletionPending'))
          }
          await deleteWorkspaceDirectory(ws.path)
          await ctx.workspaces.delete(workspaceId)

        run().then(() => {

        }).catch((e) => {
          console.warn('[dsh-workspace-menu] delete workspace disk failed', e)
          flashMessage(t('toast.deleteFailed', { reason: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }))
        })
      },
    })
  }

function handleRowEvent(event: MouseEvent, ctx: ClientContext): void {
  const state = loadState()
  if (event.type === 'dblclick' && !isFeatureEnabled(state, 'dblclick')) return
  if (event.type === 'contextmenu' && !isFeatureEnabled(state, 'contextmenu')) return
  const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : undefined
  const row = target?.closest<HTMLElement>('[role="treeitem"]')
  if (!row) return
  const info = rowInfo(row)
  if (!info) return
  if (event.type === 'contextmenu') event.preventDefault()
  if (event.type !== 'dblclick' && event.type !== 'contextmenu') return
  event.stopPropagation()
  const items = info.kind === 'workspace'
    ? workspaceMenu(ctx, info.id, info.title)
    : sessionMenu(ctx, info.id, info.title)
  if (items.length === 0) return
  showMenu(event.clientX, event.clientY, items)
}

 * Deep-link support: `?session=<id>` opens that session once the catalog
 * knows it. 0.2.x has no built-in URL routing, so the plugin owns it and
 * navigates through the view owner (`ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession`).
 */
function handleDeepLink(ctx: ClientContext): () => void {
  const target = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('session')
  if (!target) return () => undefined
  let tries = 0
  const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    tries += 1
    const byId = ctx.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId
    if (byId[target]) {
      window.clearInterval(timer)
      ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(target)

      // Try one explicit refresh before giving up.
      ctx.sessions.refresh().then(() => {
        if (ctx.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[target]) ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(target)
      }).catch(() => undefined)
    }
  }, 250)
  return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
}

// once. New DSH WebServer versions reject duplicate exact routes, so route

function header(headers: HttpRequest['headers'], name: string): string | undefined {
  const value = headers[name]

function parseAuthority(authority: string): URL | undefined {
  try {
    return new URL(`http://${authority}`)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function isLoopbackHostname(hostname: string): boolean {
  if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '[::1]') return true
  const parts = hostname.split('.')
  return parts.length === 4
    && parts[0] === '127'
    && parts.every(part => /^\d{1,3}$/.test(part) && Number(part) <= 255)
}

function canonicalAuthority(entry: string, entryUrl: URL): string {
  const port = entryUrl.port !== '' ? entryUrl.port : new URL(`https://${entry}`).port
  return port === '' ? entryUrl.hostname : `${entryUrl.hostname}:${port}`
}

function isTrustedAuthority(hostUrl: URL, trustedHosts: readonly string[]): boolean {
  return trustedHosts.some((entry) => {
    const entryUrl = parseAuthority(entry)
    if (entryUrl === undefined) return false
    return canonicalAuthority(entry, entryUrl) === entryUrl.hostname
      ? entryUrl.hostname === hostUrl.hostname
      : entryUrl.host === hostUrl.host
  })
}

function isTrustedApiRequest(req: HttpRequest, trustedHosts: readonly string[]): boolean {
  const host = header(req.headers, 'host')

  const hostUrl = parseAuthority(host)

  if (!isLoopbackHostname(hostUrl.hostname) && !isTrustedAuthority(hostUrl, trustedHosts)) return false
  if (header(req.headers, 'sec-fetch-site') === 'cross-site') return false
  const origin = header(req.headers, 'origin')
  if (origin === undefined) return true
  try {
    return new URL(origin).host === hostUrl.host
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

async function readJsonBody(req: HttpRequest): Promise<unknown> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = []

    size += chunk.length
    if (size > 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('body too large')
    chunks.push(chunk)

  const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')

function spawnOpener(cmd: string, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false
    const child = spawn(cmd, args, { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' })
    child.on('error', (error) => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      reject(error)
    })
    child.on('spawn', () => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      child.unref()
      resolve()
    })
    child.on('exit', (code) => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      if (code === 0 || code === null) resolve()
      else reject(new Error(`opener exited with code ${String(code)}`))
    })
  })
}

async function openInOs(rawPath: string): Promise<void> {
  const path = normalize(rawPath)
  if (process.platform === 'win32') {
    const explorer = process.env.SystemRoot
      ? join(process.env.SystemRoot, 'explorer.exe')
      : 'explorer.exe'
    const args = isDirectoryPath(path) ? [path] : [`/select,${path}`]
    await spawnOpener(explorer, args)
    return
  }
  if (process.platform === 'darwin') {
    await spawnOpener('open', [path])
    return
  }
  // Linux：优先 xdg-open，缺失或不可用时依次尝试常见文件管理器。
  const candidates: Array<{ cmd: string; args: string[] }> = [
    { cmd: 'xdg-open', args: [path] },
    { cmd: 'gio', args: ['open', path] },
    { cmd: 'nautilus', args: [path] },
    { cmd: 'dolphin', args: [path] },
    { cmd: 'thunar', args: [path] },
    { cmd: 'pcmanfm', args: [path] },
  ]
  let lastError: unknown
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    try {
      await spawnOpener(candidate.cmd, candidate.args)
      return
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error
    }
  }
  throw lastError instanceof Error ? lastError : new Error('no file manager available')
}

 *
 * DSH keeps one directory per Session under
 * `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace-slug>/<sessionId>/`, and the directory name
 * is the Session identity. The search stays inside the sessions root and
 * only ever matches a directory whose name equals the requested identity.
 */
function findSessionRecord(sessionId: string): string | undefined {
  if (!isValidSessionId(sessionId)) return undefined
  const root = join(dshHome(), 'sessions')
  let entries: import('node:fs').Dirent[]
  try {
    entries = readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true })
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue
    const candidate = join(root, entry.name, sessionId)
    try {
      if (existsSync(candidate) && statSync(candidate).isDirectory()) return candidate
    } catch {
      // unreadable bucket — keep looking
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

function isValidSessionId(id: string): boolean {
  return id !== '.' && id !== '..' && /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$/.test(id)

async function processPending(ctx: AppContext, id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (pendingInFlight.has(id)) return false
  pendingInFlight.add(id)
  try {
    // Unarchiving explicitly cancels a queued deletion.
    if (!ctx.workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds.includes(id)) {
      await rm(pendingPath(id), { force: true })
      return false
    }
    if (ctx.sessions.get(id)) return false
    const snapshot = await ctx.sessionPersistence.stat(id)
    if (snapshot !== undefined) {
      const handle = await ctx.sessionPersistence.open(id, 'write')
      const record = findSessionRecord(id)
      await handle.close()
      if (!record) throw new Error('session record not found under DSH_HOME')
      if (ctx.sessions.get(id)) return false
      await rm(record, { recursive: true, force: true })
    } else if (findSessionRecord(id)) {
      throw new Error('session storage could not be verified')
    }
    for (const workspace of ctx.workspaceRegistry.list()) {
      if (workspace.sessionIds.includes(id)) await workspace.detachSession(id)
    }
    await ctx.workspaceRegistry.unpinSession(id)
    await ctx.workspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession(id)
    await rm(pendingPath(id), { force: true })
    return true
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[dsh-workspace-menu] pending deletion will be retried', id, error)
    return false
  } finally {
    pendingInFlight.delete(id)
  }
}

    if (isValidSessionId(id)) await processPending(ctx, id)
